subject: Re: BrightGrid MAP — ramp checkpoints, incentives & final commercial ask
messages:
From: Alex Berman <alex.berman@brightgrid.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: BrightGrid MAP kickoff — ramp milestones and incentives

Priya — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our execs asked for a short mutual action plan that ties commercial incentives to measurable MAP checkpoints during the 90-day evaluation. High level asks from our side: 

- A staged pricing schedule that gives increasing discounts as we hit ramp checkpoints (pilot -> beta -> production).
- Clear acceptance criteria per checkpoint (throughput, latency P95, regression window).
- A short-term SLA commitment for our evaluation phase and a crediting mechanism if we miss performance.

Can you share an example MAP with specific dollar/commit thresholds and the kinds of acceptance tests you want to run? We need this to align procurement/legal with the engineering team. CCing contracts@brightgrid.com.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Berman
Head of Platform Partnerships | BrightGrid
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Berman <alex.berman@brightgrid.com>
Cc: contracts@brightgrid.com
Date: 2026-09-06T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightGrid MAP kickoff — ramp milestones and incentives

Alex — really appreciate the clear asks. Draft attached (BrightGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx) + a short SLA-draft.pdf that maps credits to P95/availability. Summary below — this is intentionally conservative so we have room to negotiate: 

Overview (90-day evaluation MAP)
- Phase 0 (Proof-of-Concept, weeks 0–2): free pilot credits (up to 200k tokens) + baseline perf tests. Success = model responds within agreed P95 and passes the 5 canonical prompts.
- Phase 1 (Beta ramp, weeks 3–6): 30% discounted usage pricing on billed tokens for first committed slab of 1M tokens. Acceptance = 95th pct latency <= 320ms and no more than 2% regression on quality evals vs baseline.
- Phase 2 (Production onramp, weeks 7–12): additional 15% discount if BrightGrid commits to a 3-month reserved slab (min 3M tokens/month) after successful Phase 1. Final acceptance includes throughput test (sustained QPS) and one live traffic shadowing test.

Additional commercial notes
- If we fail to meet the P95 or availability targets, Redwood proposes pro-rated credits (line-item in SLA-draft.pdf).
- DocuSign path will be provided for the MAP + a short order form once you pick the ramp option.

Attachments: BrightGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP table + milestone matrix), SLA-draft.pdf (crediting math)

Next steps: if this looks directionally correct, can we lock down which ramp scenario (A: conservative commit; B: accelerated commit with higher discount) you prefer so I can push a formal quote?

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightGrid MAP kickoff — ramp milestones and incentives

Looping in commercial math. Priya — see inline suggestions below on the discount structure and acceptance thresholds. Short summary of our recommended revisions: 

- Move Beta ramp discount from 30% to 25% as baseline; reserve an accelerator rebate (additional 5–10%) if BrightGrid stretches commit to a 6-month term. This protects blended unit economics for the first quarter.
- Replace absolute P95 latency number with relative degradation cap: no worse than +15% vs baseline measured during Phase 0. That avoids penalizing them when baseline load varies.
- Add a single-run synthetic throughput test spec (QPS ramp to X over 10 mins) and require both sides to run the test via shared scripts (we'll provide).

Also flag: if they require a formal SLA with financial penalties beyond credits, we should escalate to leadership for approval (will slow close).

Ben — ok to include an optional waived onboarding fee if we push a 6-month reserved slab?

Karthik
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Berman <alex.berman@brightgrid.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@brightgrid.com
Date: 2026-09-07T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightGrid MAP kickoff — ramp milestones and incentives

Thanks Priya & team — this is helpful. A few clarifications from BrightGrid legal/eng: 

- We prefer a clear dollar-for-discount table (helps procurement). Can you put both options (25%/30%) in a quote so we can show our CFO?
- For acceptance criteria, the relative degradation approach is fine, but we need an explicit test harness/drive script and a signed time window for the synthetic runs.
- Ramp cadence ask: can Phase 1 include an optional accelerated path (Month 1: 30% of projected usage; Month 2: 60%; Month 3: 100%) tied to an additional 5% rebate if met? That helps our product timeline.

We want to move quickly — if you can provide a final commercial summary + a DocuSign route for the chosen option, we can get procurement to sign within 72 hours.

On Tue, 2026-09-06 at 16:18, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Looping in commercial math. Priya — see inline suggestions below on the discount structure and acceptance thresholds.

Appreciate it — Alex
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Berman <alex.berman@brightgrid.com>, contracts@brightgrid.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Final commercial summary + next steps (two options) — BrightGrid MAP

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached: BG-FINAL-quote.pdf (two-option quote) and I pasted the executive summary below. DocuSign link and HubSpot record included in related_links.

Executive summary (two options)
- Option A (Conservative commit)
  - Phase 1 discount: 25% on first 1M tokens during Beta
  - Phase 2 discount: 15% additional when BrightGrid signs a 3-month reserved slab at 3M tokens/month
  - Ramp schedule: standard (no accelerator).
  - Onboarding fee: standard (waived with 6-month commit).

- Option B (Accelerated ramp + bonus rebate)
  - Phase 1 discount: 30% on first 1M tokens
  - Additional 5% rebate if the accelerated ramp is met (Month1=30%, Month2=60%, Month3=100% of projected usage). Rebate applied as a credit on month 4 invoice.
  - Phase 2: same 15% if they convert to reserved commitment.

Acceptance & test plan
- Shared test harness will be provided by Redwood; synthetic runs scheduled during mutually agreed windows in Phase 1.
- Acceptance measured as relative degradation <= 15% vs Phase 0 baseline and no regression >2% on quality evals. Full acceptance matrix in attached MAP.

Next steps
1) Tell us Option A or B (we recommended B if they can commit to the accelerated ramp).
2) We’ll send DocuSign for the MAP + short order form.
3) Kickoff integration calls; Redwood to provide test scripts and shadowing plan.

Attachments: BG-FINAL-quote.pdf, BrightGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), SLA-draft.pdf

Thanks — I’ll monitor and push the DocuSign link as soon as you confirm which option.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198
